CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of My purpose Talents and abilities? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My purpose Talents and abilities.
   B. Say My purpose Talents and abilities has no place in daily life.
   C. Use My purpose Talents and abilities to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of My purpose Talents and abilities with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Fall of Man? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Fall of Man.
   D. Say The Fall of Man has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Family Unity? (1 mark)

   B. Apply the teaching of Family Unity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   D. Use Family Unity to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately

7. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

8. Which response best shows understanding of The Birth of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Birth of Moses has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The Birth of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Birth of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Birth of Moses.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Mount Carmel Contest? (1 mark)

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

12. Which response best shows understanding of The call of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The call of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The call of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The call of Moses has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The call of Moses.

13. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible as a Guide? (1 mark)

14. Which response best shows understanding of Noah and his sons? (1 mark)

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Noah and his sons.
   D. Use Noah and his sons to insult classmates of other faiths.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple.
   B. Apply the teaching of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain The Early Church 3 4.2 The Lords Supper 3 4.3 The Holy Spirit 3 4.4 Peter Miracu and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Friendship formation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
